name: text-effect
use: Headline entrance per word or letter (fade, blur, slide)
description: Easily animate text content with various effects. You can apply animations per character or per word, and customize the animation effects using custom variants or preset animations.

name: text-loop
use: Cycle a few words in a headline
description: Text animation that transitions between multiple items, creating an engaging looping effect.

name: text-morph
use: Button label that morphs between states
description: Animates text by morphing shared letters between words, creating fluid transitions.

name: text-roll
use: Rolling letters on hover or entrance
description: A text roll component that rotates each character, fully customizable for nice text animations.

name: text-scramble
use: Scrambled text that resolves, for tech brands
description: Text animation that transforms text by randomly cycling through characters before settling on the final content, creating an engaging cryptographic effect.

name: text-shimmer
use: Shimmer for "loading" or AI status text
description: Shimmer effect on text. Easily adjust the duration and the spread of the shimmer effect.

name: text-shimmer-wave
use: Wave shimmer across letters
description: Shimmer wave effect on text. Easily adjust the wave effect, spread, duration, and more.

name: spinning-text
use: Circular rotating badge text
description: Easily animate text circularly. Customize the animation with variants and transitions.

name: animated-number
use: Count up a metric with a spring
description: Easily animate numbers.

name: sliding-number
use: Odometer-style digits for prices or counters
description: A component that slides numbers.

name: in-view
use: Animate a block when it scrolls into view
description: Easily animate elements when they come into view. You can apply animations to elements when they enter the viewport, or when they are fully visible.

name: animated-group
use: Stagger a list or grid of children

name: scroll-progress
use: Reading progress bar
description: Animated scroll progress for your web pages.

name: progressive-blur
use: Blur that fades over an image edge or scroller
description: A Progressive Blur component creates a layered blur effect using motion and gradient masks. It progressively blurs layers based on direction and intensity, adding visual depth.

name: infinite-slider
use: Logo wall or marquee loop
description: Infinite scrolling slider component that smoothly loops through its children. It supports both horizontal and vertical directions, with customizable speed and speed on hover. Ideal for creating continuous carousels, marquee displays, or dynamic content showcases.

name: spotlight
use: Soft light following the cursor inside a card
description: A dynamic spotlight effect component that follows cursor movement.

name: glow-effect
use: Animated glow behind a card or button
description: A customizable glow effect with animation modes, colors, blur-sm, and transitions.

name: border-trail
use: Light travelling around a border
description: Animated border effect that moves along the edges of its parent container.

name: tilt
use: Subtle 3D tilt on hover
description: 3D tilt effect that responds to mouse movement, enhancing UI elements with a dynamic depth effect, customizable rotation factors and spring options.

name: magnetic
use: Element drifting toward the cursor
description: A magnetic effect for elements that allows them to be attracted to the mouse cursor.

name: cursor
use: Custom cursor or cursor-attached label
description: A custom cursor component with optional spring animations. It can be globally applied to the page or attached specifically to a parent element.

name: accordion
use: FAQ and expandable lists
description: A vertically stacked set of collapsible containers allowing users to toggle content visibility. Customize the animation effects with variants and transitions for expanding/collapsing the sections.

name: disclosure
use: Show more / less block
description: The Disclosure component allows users to toggle the visibility of content, either collapsed or expanded.

name: animated-background
use: Sliding highlight for tabs, nav and segmented controls
description: Visually highlights selected items by sliding a background into view when hovered over or clicked. This smooth transition helps users focus on the active item, making it ideal for interactive lists, menus, or navigations where clear selection feedback is important.

name: transition-panel
use: Animated tab or step content
description: Easy way to switch between different pieces of content with enter and exit animations. It's perfect for enhancing user experience in areas such as onboarding card, settings adjustments, or any interactive content that requires a visual transition between states.

name: carousel
use: Accessible carousel with controls
description: A flexible and easy-to-use carousel with customizable navigation and indicators.

name: image-comparison
use: Before and after slider
description: Interactively compare two images with a draggable slider to reveal differences.

name: dock
use: macOS-style dock
description: A versatile UI element that provides a flexible and customizable way to organize and display menu items within your application.

name: toolbar-dynamic
use: Toolbar that expands into a search or form
description: Adjusts width dynamically to accommodate varying tool requirements. Starts small and expands to offer more tools as needed.

name: toolbar-expandable
use: Toolbar with expanding panels
description: Changes height based on content, expanding to display more tools and shrinking to save space. Keeps your screen organized and efficient.

name: dialog
use: Modal dialog with motion
description: A window overlaid on either the primary window or another dialog window, rendering the content underneath inert. Customize the dialog with variants and transition.

name: morphing-dialog
use: Card that morphs into a full dialog
description: A dialog that uses layout animations to transition content into a focused view. It supports click-outside and escape key functionalities for closing.

name: morphing-popover
use: Button that morphs into a popover
description: A popover that transforms from its trigger into the content using layout animations. It visually morphs instead of appearing as a separate element.
